title: Glessner's second-floor windows taller, on their carved stone course
items: The eleven second-floor windows on Prairie Avenue now come down to 19.2 ft, as HABS sheet 6 and the 1965 photograph show. They were 19.8, so each window is now 5.1 ft tall, and the colonnettes between them stand on the sill with taller bases and capitals. The carved band under the group of four is now the full stone course the drawing shows, about a foot deep and directly under the sill. Its egg-and-dart reaches further each way, and its end blocks are wider.
